title: nb sync and lint: smaller mismatches reported in the spec review (unverified)
body:
Found in the spec-vs-code review of branch `worktree-agent-af4147e78b41b3bce` on 2026-11-09. Line numbers are that branch.

Reported by reviewers; not re-checked.

- `merge_lists` dedups by canonical JSON, so two identical log entries added on one side become one.
- Push retry makes 3 attempts in total; SPEC says retry up to 3 times.
- `updated` changed on both sides takes the later date; unrelated histories merge against an empty base; merged `meta.json` drops keys other than schema and config.
- Lint does not re-check freeze requirements (spec, execution, predictions, builds-on) on already-frozen nodes. `test_old_frozen_nodes_not_rechecked` asserts this for builds-on, but SPEC says lint re-checks all write rules.
- Inner shapes of `deviations`, `runs`, `provenance` and `log` entries are not validated.
- `nb query --text` does not search `user_words`, prediction metric or rule, deviations, verdict basis or review notes; `--json` gives no sign of truncation at 50.
